title: 13 Arasain Na Mara, Grattan Road, Salthill, Galway, H91X7YC

description:
O'Donnellan & Joyce Auctioneers are delighted to offer for sale this excellent first-floor apartment situated right by the promenade in the sought-after Salthill location of Galway City. 

Arasain Na Mara is a well-managed apartment complex with lift access & underground parking. 

The complex is ideally situated on the doorstep of Salthill promenade. Arasain Na Mara also benefits greatly by local amenities that Salthill has to offer & is within walking distance of Galway City. 

No.13 Arasain Na Mara is a spacious two-bedroom apartment situated on the first floor of the secure residential complex. 

Comprising approximately 64 sq.m, this beautiful apartment is presented in excellent condition, having been upgraded throughout by current owner. 

The condition is evident immediately with upgraded radiators, new flooring, as well as modern bathroom & kitchen fittings. 

With accommodation comprising of two spacious bedrooms, both with fitted wardrobes & one availing of bay views, a modern main bathroom, and an open-plan reception area with kitchen unit & access to a private balcony. 

This property also benefits from its own designated underground parking spot and storage unit.

Situated right in the sought-after Salthill locale, Arasain Na Mara is within close proximity to several popular landmarks, including being adjacent to Salthill Village & Promenade, close proximity to Blackrock diving tower, Galway Lawn Tennis Club & Galway Golf Club, as well as being within walking distance to Galway City Centre, the popular West End & the vibrant Latin Quarter. 

13 Arasain Na Mara is an ideal property for all purchasers due to the well-proportioned accommodation on offer, excellent condition & ideal location in one of Galway's most popular residential areas. 

Viewing is highly recommended.

Properties can be viewed on our website www.odj.ie
